inputs: terrain.npz contains all inputs and float64 outputs; deterministic hand-built heterogeneous 4x5 DEM with positive and negative relief, 200 m spacing, six elevations 500-8000 m; no random seed needed
conventions: upward coordinates; downward g_z mGal; density sign follows surface-reference; infinite slab at observation cell; G=6.67430e-11

benchmark_normalized.reason: Maximum absolute error divided by maximum absolute reference per output and altitude; no absolute floor. At 700 m use the campaign target; higher altitude permits the existing far-field cancellation allowance. Slab uses its existing float32 arithmetic bound.

inputs_benchmark_regime.note: First 256 coordinates reproduce bench/run_bench.py medium; remaining heights use the same horizontal points. Inputs are float32 before float64 reference evaluation.
